title: The Pro looks
thisBuild: Settings, Look: Classic (as before), Pro dark or Pro light. The Pro looks put your pixel icons on every bar: the top bar, the bottom bar and the tabs, on printed rails (dark dots, or cream paper like your prints).
Tile colors mean something: yellow for transport, purple for pages, pink for playing tools, teal for sound shaping, slate for housekeeping.
A small word sits under each icon until you know them; Settings, Look, Words under icons turns them off.
In the Pro looks the tempo button shows the lag in milliseconds under the BPM, so you can watch for a creep while you play.
Hold, Echo and Song got new icons (a pinned pad, an eye with sound rings, a music note).
watch: Try both Pro looks on the cover screen and opened: does the cream rail glare? Do the icons read?
Any icon you'd redraw: send a note naming it.
limits: The side dock keeps its words in every look; its pieces are sliders and wheels more than buttons.
Sheets (Settings, Sample, Messes) look the same in every look for now.
